findings.highlight: There's usually a limit to how much force one can use to turn a slow curse into an immediate curse.
findings.evidenceJa: 実力行使にも程がある
findings.governingReading: 実力行使にも程がある is the reaction that even using force has its limits: she has overdone turning a leisurely curse into an immediate attack.
findings.explanation: An exclamation about excessive force becomes a usual technical limit on converting curses.

findings.highlight: We glare at each other again... But I have to...!
findings.evidenceJa: 再度睨みあう—なんて余裕はない
findings.governingReading: 再度睨みあう—なんて余裕はない denies time for the envisaged stare-down and immediately sends Shirou back into the hall.
findings.explanation: A denied stare-down becomes an actual exchange of glares.

findings.evidenceJa: 当然、タダで済むほど甘くないわ
findings.governingReading: Rin says the attack is not so mild as to leave him unharmed; Shirou later calls her stupid while mocking her breathlessness. Neither line adds jackass or an asthma comparison.
findings.explanation: Rin’s answer and Shirou’s later taunt gain new insults.

findings.highlight: It's your fault I have to focus my fire! A moving target's harder!
findings.evidenceJa: 標的が動きまわるから、狙いに熱が入る
findings.governingReading: 狙いに熱が入る says the moving target makes her get enthusiastic or heated about aiming, within her blame-shifting retort.
findings.explanation: Rin getting carried away aiming becomes necessary concentration on a harder target.

findings.evidenceJa: やる気満々でこっちを睨んでいる遠坂
findings.governingReading: やる気満々でこっちを睨んでいる depicts an eager-to-fight glare directed at him.
findings.explanation: The determined glare blocking the stairs becomes a confident smile.

findings.highlight: now they're torching everything in their path.
findings.evidenceJa: 触れた箇所をごっそりと焼き削る
findings.governingReading: 触れた箇所をごっそりと焼き削る contrasts mere hot grazes with burning away the area touched; his immediately following thigh graze slows him.
findings.explanation: Burning and gouging the grazed body part becomes torching everything in the shots’ path.

findings.evidenceJa: 触れる物全てを弾き飛ばしていく
findings.governingReading: 弾き飛ばす specifies knocking or flinging objects away, illustrated by the desks dancing wildly.
findings.explanation: Objects flung away by the magical mass become objects destroyed.

findings.highlight: Those aren't something I can afford to give
findings.evidenceJa: 令呪は差し出せる物じゃない
findings.governingReading: 令呪は差し出せる物じゃない objects to their being a handable thing, before the separate more important reason of betraying Saber.
findings.explanation: Command Spells not being an item to hand over becomes something he cannot afford to give.

findings.highlight: A hail of bullets mercilessly fly
findings.evidenceJa: 廊下から弾丸が連発された
findings.governingReading: A hail takes flies, plural wounds take are, and the head sound takes echoes.
findings.explanation: Subject-agreement defects recur across the chase and rescue.
